community (Reddit) ladder on one B70 with Qwen3.8-27B GPTQ INT4 weights (fp8 KV, prefix caching on); gains plateau at MTP2 (x1.57) because the verify step is compute-limited on XPU. Earlier evidence labeled this ladder Qwen3.6-27B; the field report names Qwen3.8-27B.
twelve-feature lab kernel stack, target-only; mean of two fresh cache-zero conventional 99-interval suite medians (site headline row)
eleven-feature stack swept at explicit depths, flash attention on; no point interpolated
draft-MTP with lab SYCL patches (AOT BMG draft path, bulk sampled-ID verifier read, fused weighted-sum); the June 2026 stock baseline of the same model on this card was 26.1 tok/s

research lane, determinism open Acceptance 0.92 is back-derived from the run's own x2.19 gain over its 46 tok/s target-only arm (the lab did not publish an accept length); research lane, determinism open. Exceeds the engine's optimized target for 2-card vLLM XPU MTP5 even at its back-derived acceptance: the research lane's tensor-parallel MTP path beats what the calibrated engine models for this stack; kept as a flagged reference, not a calibration anchor.
mean of four clean long repeats

llama.cpp SYCL TP4 (lab distributed ARGMAX / local-winner reuse) with the published 2.6B Muse assistant as a BF16 draft model, n-draft 15; canonical full-256 means 100.1 / 100.6 Exceeds the engine's optimized target: the lab's converted BF16 DFlash draft on 4-card llama.cpp SYCL costs far less per drafted token than the generic draft-model path models (measured x2.67 over its target-only arm); flagged reference, not a calibration anchor.
community Docker/vLLM setup re-run by the lab; FP8 on Arc is emulated

grouped-w4a16-piecewise-graph-r14: one coherent measured sweep (persistent raw-engine batching, temp 0, 2 repeats). XPU Graphs are captured only at batch 1/32/64, so 2-16 users run off-graph and aggregate throughput dips below one user at B2 - a capture-shape artifact of this tuned stack, not a scaling law. perUserTokS is aggregate/users by definition. B64 fixed-seed determinism unresolved (27/64) - experimental evidence, not a promoted recipe.
combined-runtime-guards-r16: separate treatment measured at B1 and B64 only; the lab forbids joining these to the r14 curve. Faster than r14 but B64 determinism still unresolved (29/64).

b2dd9ce73d/1e90ffa672 zero-overlay vLLM XPU (dated current-main, no lab kernel patches), graph on, f16 KV, MTP0, exact flat-token active-context requests, 128 output tokens, 99-interval median; full quality battery passed; depth 0 not measured
